justification: Both depict human beings, but that is the extent of the correspondence: A is a low-relief narrative siege scene with archers on crenellated towers, a wheeled siege engine and gated walls, arranged in a horizontal register with figures in strict profile; B is a stacked three-dimensional column of frontal, staring faces with schematic incised brows and no scene, setting or action. There is no shared relationship, arrangement or drawing convention — profile narrative relief versus frontal iconic head-stack.
